PUBLIC COMMENTS
The public is encouraged to address the Planning Commission on items listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. If you wish to address the City Council or any of its Agencies, you may do so during the PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS period noted on the agenda. Each person is allowed three (3) minutes speaking time. A Spanish speaking interpreter is available for your convenience.
COMENTARIOS DEL PUBLICO
Se invita al público a dirigirse al Concilio o cualquiera otra de sus Agencias nombradas en esta agenda, para hablar sobre cualquier asunto publicado en la agenda o cualquier tema que esté bajo su jurisdicción. Si usted desea la oportunidad de dirigirse al Concilio o alguna de sus Agencias, podrá hacerlo durante el período de Comentarios del Público (Public Communications) anunciado en la agenda. A cada persona se le permite hablar por tres (3) minutos. Hay un intérprete para su conveniencia.

STAFF REPORT
SET MATTERS - PUBLIC HEARINGS (7:00 P.M. or as soon thereafter as the matter can be heard).
If in the future you wish to challenge the following in court, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice or in written correspondence delivered to the Planning Commission Secretary and/or Planning Commission at or prior to the public hearing.
2)
A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A ZONE VARIANCE FROM SECTION 153.130.060.B.1 OF THE CITY'S ZONING CODE IN ORDER TO ALLOW A SEVEN (7) FOOT TALL WROUGHT-IRON FENCE THAT EXCEEDS THE MAXIMUM ALLOWABLE HEIGHT ALONG THE FRONT PROPERTY LINE ADJACENT TO THE PUBLIC RIGHT OF WAY. (LOCATION: 4725 CENTER STREET; APPLICANT: RICHARD STINSON REPRESENTING VALLEY VIEW MUTUAL WATER COMPANY; CASE NUMBER: ZV-715). Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Planning Commission Resolution PC 17-11 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK APPROVING A ZONE VARIANCE TO ALLOW A WROUGHT IRON FENCE ALONG THE FRONT PROPERTY LINE ADJACENT TO THE PUBLIC RIGHT OF WAY TO EXCEED THE MAXIMUM ALLOWABLE HEIGHT WITHIN THE R-1, SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL ZONE. (LOCATION: 4725 CENTER STREET; APPLICANT: RICHARD STINSON REPRESENTING VALLEY VIEW MUTUAL WATER COMPANY; CASE NUMBER: ZV-715)."
STAFF REPORT
3)
A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR AMBULANCE SERVICES IN AN EXISTING 10,400 S.F. BUILDING LOCATED WITHIN THE INDUSTRIAL COMMERCIAL, IC ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE. (LOCATION: 13329 GARVEY AVENUE; APPLICANT: CARE AMBULANCE SERVICE INC.; CASE NO.: CP-851). Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 17-10 "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK APPROVING A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR AMBULANCE SERVICES IN AN EXISTING BUILDING, WITHIN THE (I-C), INDUSTRIAL COMMERCIAL ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 OF THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 13329 GARVEY AVENUE; APPLICANT CARE AMBULANCE SERVICE INC.; CASE NO. CP-851)."
STAFF REPORT
4)
A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR THE ON-SITE SALES OF BEER AND WINE (TYPE 41) WITH LIVE ENTERTAINMENT AT AN EXISTING RESTAURANT LOCATED WITHIN THE C-2, GENERAL COMMERCIAL ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 1628 PUENTE AVENUE; APPLICANT: HIPOLITO SERRANO; CASE NUMBER: CP-849) Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 17-08 "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVING A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT ALLOWING THE ON-SITE SALES OF BEER AND WINE (TYPE 41) ABC LICENSE IN CONJUNCTION LIVE ENTERTAINMENT AT AN EXISTING RESTAURANT, PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 1628 PUENTE AVENUE; APPLICANT: HIPOLITO SERRANO; CASE NUMBER: CP-849.)"
STAFF REPORT
5)
A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF THE FOLLOWING: (1) A MODIFICATION TO INCLUDE THE APPROVED WAREHOUSE USE FOR 10 INDIVIDUAL UNITS (A-J), (2) TO MODIFY EXHIBIT "A" OF CP-827 FOR CHANGES TO THE SITE PLAN, (3) TO DELETE CONDITION NO. 13 OF ITS ADOPTED RESOLUTION PC 16-02 AS IT RELATES TO NOISE COMPLAINTS, AND (4) A TENTATIVE TRACT MAP TO SUBDIVIDE THE PROPOSED BUILDING INTO TEN (10) INDIVIDUAL WAREHOUSE CONDOMINIUM UNITS AND ONE COMMON LOT WITHIN THE I, INDUSTRIAL ZONE PURSUANT TO SECTION 153.210.130.C AND 152.10 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE. (LOCATION: 5115 AZUSA CANYON RD. UNITS A THRU J; APPLICANT: KEVIN STALEY, THE MAGELLAN GROUP; CASE NO.: CP-827MOD AND TM-74854) Staff recommends that the Planning Commission open the public hearing and following the public hearing adopt Resolution PC 17-12 "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVING A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT MODIFICATION TO CP-827 AND A TENTATIVE TRACT MAP FOR CONDOMINIUM PURPOSES TO SUBDIVIDE ONE (1) LOT INTO TEN (10) UNITS AND A COMMON LOT FOR A PROPOSED 97,945 SQUARE FOOT BUILDING WITHIN THE I, INDUSTRIAL ZONE, PURSUANT TO TABLE 153.050.020 AND SECTION 152.10 IN THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 5115 AZUSA CANYON ROAD; APPLICANT: KEVIN STALEY, THE MAGELLAN GROUP; CASE NUMBER: CP-827MOD AND TM-74854.)"
STAFF REPORT

NONE

Planning Division Monthly Report for May, 2017.

Verbal update on the proposed Irwindale Materials Recovery Facility and Transfer Station (Location: 2200 Arrow Highway; Applicant: Athens Services)

CERTIFICATION
I, Amy Harbin, Planning Commission Secretary hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.
PLEASE NOTE: Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to each item on this agenda are available for public viewing and inspection at City Hall, 14403 E. Pacific Avenue, 2nd Floor Lobby Area or at the Los Angeles County Public Library in the City of Baldwin Park, 4181 Baldwin Park Blvd. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the Planning Department at 626.813-5261 or via e-mail at aharbin@baldwinpark.com
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the Public Works Department or Risk Management at 626.960.4011. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable staff to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 34.102.104 ADA TITLE II)
